ajuda.maisAjuda: Did not find what you were looking for?

1.resposta: You have up to 5 feathers. Each mistake in a lesson costs one, and one feather comes back every hour. You can also get feathers in the shop or by watching an ad. With PRO, feathers are unlimited.

2.resposta: Your streak counts the days in a row in which you finish at least one lesson. If a day goes by without study, it resets to zero, unless you have gas saved.

3.resposta: Each gas covers one day without study, and you can keep up to 2. You buy it in the shop with rupees. PRO members get one protected day per week.

4.resposta: By finishing lessons, completing goals and opening barrels. Rupees buy shop items such as feathers and gas. They are never sold for money.

5.resposta: Your division depends on the XP you have collected. Every week there is a table with people in the same division, and the top 3 reach the podium.

6.resposta: Unlimited feathers, double XP and rupees, one protected streak day per week and no ads. You can try it free for 7 days and cancel anytime in Settings, My subscription.

7.pergunta: Does switching courses erase my progress?
7.resposta: No. Each course keeps its own progress; switching only changes what shows on your Journey.

8.pergunta: I forgot my password. What now?
8.resposta: On the sign-in screen, tap "Forgot password". A code arrives in your email so you can create a new password.
